About

Susy, and the one-chair salon she built.

The Q Salon for Men opened in downtown Sarasota in November 2021 with a simple idea: one master stylist, one chair, and men's grooming done properly.

Book with Susy →See the menu

Master barber & stylist

Meet Susy

Susy has more than ten years of experience cutting men's hair. She's known for fades that blend clean every time, executive cuts that still look right weeks later, and gray blending so natural nobody can tell.

She is the only stylist at The Q. Every haircut, fade, color and facial on the menu is done by her, start to finish, so you get the same hands and the same standard on every visit.

How The Q works

Fewer clients. Better cuts.

One chair, appointments only. There's no waiting room and no walk-in line. Your time is reserved, and it starts when you arrive.

A consultation every time. How you wear it, how often you come in, and how it should look in week three, not just day one.

Everything men need, in one place. Haircuts, skin fades, executive cuts, natural gray blending, the Gentleman's Facial, kids' cuts, and the products Susy finishes with, available in the Q Shop.

Downtown and easy to reach. 1415 1st St, Sarasota, FL 34236, near Main Street and Five Points, about 10 minutes from Lido Key and St. Armands.
